verdict.rationale: Cursor documents official TypeScript/Python SDKs (@cursor/sdk) that let developers script the same agent used in the IDE/CLI/web, with both Local and Cloud runtimes, service-account/API-key auth, and an open SDK Bridge for other languages, plus a live Cookbook with end-to-end examples. This is corroborated by a documented, machine-verified live API (Cloud Agents API with OpenAPI spec, key-gated endpoint confirmed via probe) and additional official APIs (Admin, Analytics, AI Code Tracking, Origin) for building integrations. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer reports of building production integrations against the SDK (only first-party docs and probes are cited).
